claim: Template library provides complete, working templates for all 32 documentation systems, making it easy to create perfect documentation that follows all standards.
Template features include complete metadata frontmatter, structured content sections, example content, placeholder guidance, validation-ready format, and copy-and-use ready templates.
Template categories include L0-L6 Technical Documentation (7 templates), Consciousness Documentation (6 templates), Planning Documentation (5 templates), and Supporting Documentation (17 templates).

Template usage workflow: Select template, customize template (update metadata, fill content), validate template (syntax, format, word counts), review & finalize (expert review, quality check, approval, commit).

Component library provides core components (CMC, HHNI, VIF, APOE, SEG), integration components (MCP, IDE, External API), and composition patterns (sequential, parallel, conditional, pipeline, event-driven, service).
MIGE uses templates for rapid idea instantiation, templates stored in templates/mige/*, templates include code/tests/documentation, quality gates ensure template compliance.
SIS analyzes template usage patterns, identifies improvement opportunities, proposes template enhancements, updates templates based on learnings.
APOE uses templates for chain construction, templates define standard chain patterns, template execution ensures consistency, quality gates validate template compliance.
Template best practices: Always start with template, fill completely (no placeholders), validate immediately, customize thoughtfully, maintain format, keep updated.

Component best practices: Design for composition (composable, clear interfaces, minimized dependencies), maintain quality (standards, tests, documentation, examples), version management (versioned, breaking changes documented, migration guides).
